# immunABC

> 🌐 [**Lea esto en
> español**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/README.es.html)

immunABC is an R package aimed at immunization (A)nalyses (B)eyond
(C)overage.

immunABC aims to support the Pan American Health Organization’s (PAHO)
Comprehensive Immunization Unit (CIM) mission by providing advanced data
analysis tools for immunization programs in the Americas. Specifically,
it facilitates the calculation of innovative indicators beyond basic
coverage, supports evidence-based decision-making through in-depth data
exploration and visualization, and contributes to strengthening data
capabilities within immunization programs by empowering human resources
to effectively leverage their data.

To learn more about PAHO’s work on immunization, visit the [PAHO
Immunization site](https://www.paho.org/en/topics/immunization).

For documentation and vignettes for this R package, see:
<https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc>.

## Installation

``` r

# Install from GitHub
devtools::install_github("IM-Data-PAHO/immunabc")
```

## Usage

Currently, immunABC contains six main modules. Follow the links below to
explore detailed vignettes with practical examples and guidance on how
to use each module:

1.  [**Nominal Dropout
    Rate**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/nominal_dropout_en.html)  
    Calculates dropout rates between any two vaccine doses using nominal
    data. This module ensures accurate follow-up tracking across a
    vaccination schedule.

2.  [**Residence vs. Occurrence
    Analyses**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/residence_occurrence_en.html)  
    Functions for comparing vaccination coverage and dose distribution
    based on where people live versus where they were vaccinated. This
    module helps identify population movement and service coverage gaps
    across geographic areas.

3.  [**Complete Schedule
    Coverage**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/complete_schedule_en.html)  
    Evaluates whether individuals have received all required doses in a
    national immunization schedule (for a specific cohort up to a
    specified age). This module differs from standard coverage
    calculation as it evaluates each individual’s compliance of the
    national immunization schedule.

4.  [**Birth Cohort
    Coverage**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/birth_cohort_coverage_en.html)  
    Lets users track and visualize vaccination status among a specific
    cohort of newborns. Helps evaluate population-level protection
    against vaccine-preventable diseases.

5.  [**Date Consistency
    Comparison**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/date_consistency_comparison_en.html)  
    Identifies and quantifies logical inconsistencies between any two
    date variables in the EIR (e.g., vaccination date before date of
    birth). Helps detect data entry errors and record linkage issues
    before downstream analyses.

6.  [**Vaccination
    Timeliness**](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/vaccination_timeliness_en.html)  
    Analyzes the vaccination timeliness of the population, that is, the
    time that elapses between the age of eligibility for each dose and
    its administration, using nominal data from the electronic
    immunization registry. Vaccinating on time, and not only completing
    the schedule, is key to protecting each individual before they reach
    the period of highest risk for the disease. Furthermore, analyzing
    vaccination timeliness allows us to understand coverage and its
    impact on the epidemiology of the disease, monitor the vaccine
    supply chain, investigate access problems or vaccination willingness
    in certain communities and, through actions at different levels,
    prevent future dropouts.

Each module works seamlessly with the example datasets provided in the
package. These examples make it easy to test out the functionality and
serve as a reference when preparing your own data. Learn more about
these example datasets [in this
vignette](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/articles/en/example_datasets_en.html).

> **Note**
>
> You can explore all the available vignettes by clicking on the
> **Guides** button in the navigation bar.

## Contribute

We welcome suggestions, bug reports, and feature requests through the
[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/IM-Data-PAHO/immunabc/issues) page.
If you’d like to contribute code or fixes, feel free to open a [pull
request](https://github.com/IM-Data-PAHO/immunabc/pulls).

# Package index

## Date Consistency Comparison

Functions for identifying and visualizing date inconsistencies in the
EIR.

- [`dcc_rate()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/dcc_rate.md)
  : (D)ate (C)onsistency (C)omparison Rate
- [`dcc_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/dcc_barplot.md)
  : (D)ate (C)onsistency (C)omparison Barplot
- [`dcc_inconsistent()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/dcc_inconsistent.md)
  : (D)ate (C)onsistency (C)omparison Inconsistent Records
- [`dcc_inconsistent_plot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/dcc_inconsistent_plot.md)
  : (D)ate (C)onsistency (C)omparison Inconsistent Records Plot

## Vaccination Timeliness

Functions for calculating and visualizing vaccination timeliness in the
EIR.

- [`vt_rate()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_rate.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Rate
- [`vt_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_barplot.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Barplot
- [`vt_inconsistent()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_inconsistent.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Inconsistent Records
- [`vt_inconsistent_plot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_inconsistent_plot.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Inconsistent Records Plot
- [`vt_distribution()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_distribution.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Distribution
- [`vt_cdf_plot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_cdf_plot.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Cumulative Distribution Plot
- [`vt_pdf_plot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_pdf_plot.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Probability Distribution Plot
- [`vt_percentile()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_percentile.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Percentiles
- [`vt_percentile_plot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/vt_percentile_plot.md)
  : (V)accination (T)imeliness Percentile Plot

## Nominal Dropout Rate

Functions for calculating and visualizing nominal dropout rate.

- [`nod_dropout()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/nod_dropout.md)
  : (No)minal (D)ropout Rate
- [`nod_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/nod_barplot.md)
  : (No)minal (D)ropout Bar Plot

## Residence vs. Ocurrence Analyses

Functions for calculating and visualizing coverage and dose distribution
by place of residence or vaccination.

- [`roc_coverage()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/roc_coverage.md)
  : (R)esidence (Oc)currence Coverage
- [`roc_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/roc_barplot.md)
  : (R)esidence (Oc)currence Bar Plot
- [`roc_distribution()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/roc_distribution.md)
  : (R)esidence (Oc)currence Dose Distribution
- [`roc_heatmap()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/roc_heatmap.md)
  : (R)esidence (Oc)currence Heatmap
- [`roc_coverage_by()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/roc_coverage_by.md)
  : (R)esidence or (Oc)currence Coverage
- [`bc_coverage()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/bc_coverage.md)
  : (B)irth (C)ohort Coverage
- [`bc_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/bc_barplot.md)
  : (B)irth (C)ohort Coverage Bar Plot

## Complete Schedule Coverage

Functions for calculating and visualizing complete schedule coverage.

- [`cs_coverage()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/cs_coverage.md)
  : (C)omplete (S)chedule Coverage
- [`cs_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/cs_barplot.md)
  : (C)omplete (S)chedule Coverage Bar Plot
- [`cs_upsetplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/cs_upsetplot.md)
  : (C)omplete (S)chedule Coverage Upset Plot

## Birth Cohort Coverage

Functions for calculating and visualizing birth cohort coverage.

- [`bc_coverage()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/bc_coverage.md)
  : (B)irth (C)ohort Coverage
- [`bc_barplot()`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/bc_barplot.md)
  : (B)irth (C)ohort Coverage Bar Plot

## Example Data

Example data frames to understand how the package works and what it
expects.

- [`immunABC.EIR`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/immunABC.EIR.md)
  : immunABC Electronic Immunization Registry (EIR)
- [`immunABC.pop.ADM0`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/immunABC.pop.ADM0.md)
  : immunABC Aggregated Population Data by ADM0
- [`immunABC.pop.ADM1`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/immunABC.pop.ADM1.md)
  : immunABC Aggregated Population Data by ADM1
- [`immunABC.pop.ADM2`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/immunABC.pop.ADM2.md)
  : immunABC Aggregated Population Data by ADM1 and ADM2
- [`immunABC.schedule`](https://im-data-paho.github.io/immunabc/reference/immunABC.schedule.md)
  : immunABC Vaccination Schedule
